expectation: Membrane rings on memory/activated T cells, a subset of CD3+ cells, plus some myeloid cells. Common in inflamed tumour: clustered in immune aggregates and stroma, scattered in the tumour, and absent from tumour nests.
observed: A: intensity differs strongly between images and is dense in immune-rich stromal bands. B and C: scattered ringed cells in stroma, with nuclear-dense nests unstained. D: membrane rings. E: CD45RO lies on much of the CD3 field (white in E3), with some CD3-only magenta.
why: Membrane-ring cells cluster in immune-rich regions, stay out of tumour nests, and overlap a subset of CD3 cells, as expected for memory T cells.
notes: CD45RO marks ringed cells in immune-rich stroma and aggregates, varies by region and sits on a subset of CD3 T cells in row E. Tumour nests stay unstained, so this is a specific population, not haze.
